text:
Olivia Nguyen: Hey everyone 👋 I’m Olivia, starting today as a Frontend Engineer on the Console team. Quick intro + setup thread. I’m PST and planning to be in the SF office next Tuesday. Two quick asks: can someone add me to the console repo? Also debating whether to request a loaner M2 for local browser/perf testing or just use my personal laptop for week one. Two truths & a lie: I once made 300 cupcakes for a bake sale, I can solve a Rubik’s cube in under 2 minutes, I trained for a month to be a salsa instructor. Which is the lie?

Nora Kim: Welcome Olivia!! :tada: Adding you to #eng-product-console. For hardware: if you’ll be doing heavy local browser profiling, request the M2; otherwise personal laptop is fine for now. I’ll ping the repo owners for invites.

IT Support: Hi Olivia — welcome! Please file hardware + access at https://redwood.internal/it-requests. If you post your GitHub handle we can pre-stage repo invites and create a yubikey + VPN ticket.

Olivia Nguyen: GitHub handle is olivia-ng. Small reproducible issue when I tried cloning the repo: Permission denied (publickey). I pasted my pub key into the IT form but wondering if there’s a quick local check I can run before the ticket is processed.

Jamal Ortiz: try `ssh -T git@github.com` first to see if your key is picked up. If it says permission denied, either the key isn’t added to your GitHub account or the ssh-agent isn’t running. On mac: `eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" && ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`. If you need help I can screenshare for 5 mins.

Maya Chen: stickers & swag update: if you’re in SF next Tuesday stop by the front desk and ask for swag pack B — cupcakes pun appreciated. Also we usually do a short intro lunch and play two truths & a lie 🚨.

DevEx Bot: Note: Olivia Nguyen added to #eng-product-console and #new-hires. Buddy assigned: Nora Kim. Onboarding checklist created: hardware pending, repo access pending.

Olivia Nguyen: Thanks all — I filed the IT request and pasted my SSH pub key. I’ll try Jamal’s ssh-agent steps and will DM if the clone still fails. Also I promise the cupcake story is real and the salsa instructor training is the lie 😉 See you in SF next week!
